SELECT StuID
FROM Student
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Has_Pet hp
    JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
    WHERE hp.StuID = Student.StuID
      AND p.PetType = 'Cat'
);
FINAL SQL:
SELECT StuID
FROM Student
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Has_Pet hp
    JOIN Pets p ON hp.PetID = p.PetID
    WHERE hp.StuID = Student.StuID
      AND p.PetType = 'Cat'
);
